**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate receipt metadata before linking the body**

When a successful response produces more than `_METADATA_LIMIT` of receipt metadata—possible with the allowed 8 KiB source/redirect URLs and selected headers—this call now fails only after `_immutable` has linked the complete body into `objects/` or `archives/`. The request remains a cache miss, so repeated acquisitions with unique bodies can accumulate permanently unreachable files up to the configured body-size limit; validate/serialize the receipt before publishing its body, as the previous implementation did.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject 304 receipts without returned validators**

For a persisted schema-2 receipt with `status == 304`, `validation_headers` may currently be empty or contain only representation metadata and still pass cache lookup. Such a receipt could never be produced by `validated_receipt`, which requires a returned matching ETag or Last-Modified value, yet offline consumers will accept it as evidence of successful validation; require at least one syntactically valid validator in the 304 validation headers.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
